info.name: SafeVoice API
info.description: Confidential Abuse & GBV Reporting Platform — REST API. Reporters are anonymous (case code + PIN); staff authenticate with JWT.

item.name: Public / Report intake
item.description:
Guided, anonymous report intake. Mirrors the Amie conversation:
start -> consent -> context -> incident -> submit. Both the WhatsApp
webhook adapter and the web portal call these same endpoints.

After `start`, every step requires the `X-Draft-Token` header
returned by `start` (drafts expire after 24h). No account, no login.

request.description:
Returns the case reference code and the PIN **exactly once**.
There is no recovery path (anonymity trade-off): the client must
instruct the reporter to save both.

item.name: Public / Anonymous follow-up
item.description:
Per-case authentication for reporters: every request carries
`X-Case-Code` + `X-Case-Pin` headers (issued at submission).
Attempts are throttled and logged; wrong code and wrong PIN return
an identical error on purpose.

response.body: {"success":false,"message":"The case code or PIN is incorrect."}

item.name: Staff / Authentication
item.description:
Staff authentication (caseworkers, supervisors, administrators) via
email + password (+ optional TOTP) returning a JWT bearer token.
Reporters never authenticate here - see the Follow-up group.

item.name: Staff / Cases
item.description:
Staff-side case operations. Row-level visibility follows the role
matrix: caseworkers see assigned cases, supervisors their unit,
administrators everything - enforced by ReportPolicy + query scope.

request.description:
Writes immutable case_status_history and (with consent) sends the
reporter a discreet status notification.
Flags the case urgent and alerts unit supervisors.

item.name: Staff / Evidence
item.description:
Evidence vault access for staff. Every list view and every download
writes an audit entry - there is no unaudited path to evidence.

item.name: Attach evidence (staff upload, e.g. scanned document)

request.description:
Verifies the integrity hash and writes an `evidence.downloaded`
audit entry. CSAM-flagged items refuse download (423-style block)
outside the restricted legal workflow.

item.name: Staff / Case messages
item.description:
Staff side of the anonymous two-way channel. Staff address the case,
never a person; delivery is routed through the tokenised identity.

item.name: Refer to a partner (moves the case to "referred")
Reference data

item.name: Localization
item.description:
Public listing of active locales; admin CRUD for enabling a new
language (adding a row is all it takes - no migration).

item.name: CMS
item.description:
Dynamic pages. Public resolution by slug (or localized slug) serves
the landing page / portal; admin CRUD behind permission `cms.manage`.

Active consent text (public - shown at intake step 2)
Admin / Users
item.description:
Staff account management. Requires permission `users.manage`.
Accounts are deactivated, never hard-deleted (audit integrity).

item.name: Admin / Roles & permissions
item.description:
Requires permission `roles.manage`. System roles (caseworker,
supervisor, administrator) cannot be deleted.

item.name: Admin / Notification templates
item.description:
Reporter-facing template bodies must stay discreet: reference code
and status wording only, never case content.

item.name: Admin / Audit trail
item.description:
Read-only. Requires permission `audit.view`. The trail is append-only
at the application layer - there is no update or delete endpoint.
